problem: Synchronous tool execution (compilation, testing) creates compute bubbles and idle GPUs, blocking agents while waiting for I/O-bound operations.
solution: Decouple inference, tool execution, and learning into parallel async components communicating via message queues.
when: Running RL training for coding agents
Tool calls have high latency (compilation, tests)
pros: High utilization - GPUs stay busy during I/O
Scalable - independently scale inference, tools, learning
